TRICKSTER ARCHER
CR 14

XP 38,400
Elf magus (eldritch archer) 12/arcane archer 2
CG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +6; Senses low-light vision; Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 18, flat-footed 20 (+6 Dex, +2 deflection, +1 natural, +5 armor, +2 shield)
hp 80 (14 HD; 12d8+2d10+12)
Fort +12, Ref +14, Will +12; +2 vs. enchantment spells and effects
Immune sleep effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (40 ft. out of armor)
Melee +1 elven curve blade +18/+13/+8 (1d10+7 S, 18–20/×2)
Ranged† +4 seeking composite longbow +22/+17/+12 (1d8+10/×3 P, range incr. 110 ft.)
Special Attacks enhance arrows (magic), imbue arrow, ranged spell combat, ranged spellstrike
Magus Spells Prepared (CL 13th, concentration +19)

0-level (at will)—acid splash, dancing lights, detect magic, flare, ray of frost
1st-level (7/day)—mount, ray of enfeeblement (DC 17), snowball (×4), true strike
2nd-level (7/day)—acid arrow, enlarged snowball, glitterdust, invisibility, mirror image, scorching ray, stone discus
3rd-level (5/day)—dispel magic, ectoplasmic snare, fireball (DC 19), haste, ray of exhaustion (DC 19)
4th-level (4/day)—black tentacles, dimension door, enlarged force hook charge, ice storm (DC 20)
5th-level (2/day)—cone of cold (DC 21), overland flight

†not including the effects of Manyshot, Rapid Shot, and spell combat

STATISTICS

Str 18 (+4), Dex 22 (+6), Con 10 (+0), Int 24 (+6), Wis 12 (+1), Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +11; CMB +13; CMD 31
Feats Enlarge Spell, Manyshot, Point-Blank Master, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (longbow), Weapon Specialization (longbow)
Skills Acrobatics +6 (15 to jump), Climb +21, Craft (bows) +13, Fly +23, Knowledge (arcana) +23, Perception +20, Ride +23, Spellcraft +18 (+20 to identify properties of magic items), Stealth +23, Swim +21; Species Modifiers +2 Perception, +2 Spellcraft to identify properties of magic items
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Sylvan
SQ arcane pool (12 points), fighter training (6th level), knowledge pool, magus arcana (arcane accuracy, concentrate, distant spellstrike, reach spellstrike), spell recall (improved spell recall), weapon familiarity
Gear +3 leather armor, +1 buckler, +4 seeking composite longbow [+4 Str] with 40 arrows, +1 elven curve blade, belt of physical might +4 (Str, Dex), amulet of natural armor +1, boots of striding and springing, cloak of resistance +3, greater bracers of archery, headband of vast intelligence +6, ring of protection +2, spellbook, 100 gp

TACTICS

The trickster loves to keep the arrows flying, and will use Rapid Shot, Manyshot, spell combat, and spellstrike to keep the damage output high. Using all of these at once they take a –4 penalty to all attacks, but they one arrow with spell combat at their highest attack bonus, then make two more attacks at their highest attack bonus (the first of which fires two arrows), then two more iterative attacks for a total of six arrows fired in the round.

The trickster will not pass up the opportunity to at least cast a damage-dealing cantrip like acid splash or ray of frost to gain the extra attack from spell combat. For a significant opponent, they’ll use a higher-damage dealing spell like snowball or a tricky spell like ectoplasmic snare. On a rare occasion, they might instead use the imbue arrow ability to deliver an area-effect spell like fireball at range.

For additional damage, the trickster can expend 1 point from their arcane pool as a swift action to add additional properties to their +4 seeking composite longbow for 1 minute. They can add up to +3 worth of additional bonuses, and will usually bring the bow to +5 seeking flaming burst—but will always judge the situation first before deciding.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Arcane Pool (Su)

An eldritch archer’s choices of weapon special abilities to apply with arcane pool at 5th level include distance, nimble shot, and returning but not dancing, keen, or vorpal. This ability modifies the magus’s arcane pool ability.

Distant Spellstrike (Su)

The range of any spell the magus delivers through a ranged weapon attack increases to the maximum range of the weapon if that is greater than the spell’s range.

Elven Magic (Ex)

Elves receive a +2 species bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance. In addition, elves receive a +2 species bonus on Spellcraft skill checks made to identify the properties of magic items.

Ranged Weapon Bond (Ex)

An eldritch archer gains a bonded object as per the wizard’s arcane bonded object; it must be a ranged weapon [in this case, the archer’s composite longbow], and it can’t be used to cast a spell once per day. Holding their bonded item does not prevent the eldritch archer from providing somatic components for their spells.

Ranged Spell Combat (Ex)

Instead of a light or one-handed melee weapon, an eldritch archer must use a ranged weapon for spell combat. They don’t need a free hand for ranged spell combat. The eldritch archer cannot accept an attack penalty to gain a bonus on concentration checks to cast a spell defensively. This ability modifies spell combat.

Ranged Spellstrike (Su)

At 2nd level, whenever an eldritch archer casts a spell that calls for a ranged attack, they can deliver the spell through a ranged weapon they wield as part of a ranged attack. Instead of the free ranged attack normally allowed to deliver the spell, an eldritch archer can make one free ranged attack with a ranged weapon (at their highest base attack bonus) as part of casting this spell. The attack does not increase the spell’s range. If the spell can normally affect multiple targets, only a single missile, ray, or effect accompanies each attack; if the spell allows multiple attacks and the eldritch archer can make additional ranged attacks as part of a full-round action with spell combat, one additional ray, missile, or effect from the spell accompanies each subsequent ranged attack the eldritch archer makes in the same round until all attacks allowed by the spell are made. Unused missiles, rays, or effects remaining at the end of the eldritch archer’s turn are wasted. This ability alters spellstrike UM.

Reach Spellstrike (Su)

The magus can deliver spells with a range of touch with ranged spellstrike up to a maximum range of close (25 feet + 5 feet per 2 caster levels).
